# openwrt_sqm_queue (Resource)

An SQM smart queue (`config queue`, package sqm-scripts).

Manages a `queue` section in `/etc/config/sqm`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Device to shape, e.g. `wan`. (UCI option `interface`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `debug_logging` (Boolean) Enable debug logging. (UCI option `debug_logging`.)
- `download` (Number) Download rate in kbit/s (0 disables ingress shaping). (UCI option `download`.)
- `egress_ecn` (String) Egress ECN: `ECN` or `NOECN`. (UCI option `egress_ecn`.)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the queue. (UCI option `enabled`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `ingress_ecn` (String) Ingress ECN: `ECN` or `NOECN`. (UCI option `ingress_ecn`.)
- `linklayer` (String) Link layer adaptation. (UCI option `linklayer`.) One of: `none`, `ethernet`, `atm`.
- `overhead` (Number) Per-packet overhead in bytes. (UCI option `overhead`.)
- `qdisc` (String) Queue discipline, e.g. `cake`. (UCI option `qdisc`.)
- `qdisc_advanced` (Boolean) Enable advanced qdisc options. (UCI option `qdisc_advanced`.)
- `script` (String) Shaper script, e.g. `piece_of_cake.qos`. (UCI option `script`.)
- `squash_dscp` (Boolean) Squash DSCP on ingress. (UCI option `squash_dscp`.)
- `squash_ingress` (Boolean) Ignore DSCP on ingress. (UCI option `squash_ingress`.)
- `upload` (Number) Upload rate in kbit/s. (UCI option `upload`.)
- `verbosity` (Number) Log verbosity. (UCI option `verbosity`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
